textEn: Cities including Copenhagen, Amsterdam, and Tokyo demonstrate that high-quality public transit combined with effective cycling infrastructure can produce urban environments that are more livable, equitable, and environmentally sustainable than car-dominated counterparts.

textEn: When cancer is found at an early stage, survival rates can be more than three times higher than when diagnosed at a later stage.
primaryTranslationVi: Khi ung thư được phát hiện ở giai đoạn đầu, tỷ lệ sống sót có thể cao hơn gấp ba lần so với khi được chẩn đoán ở giai đoạn sau.
